title: New files in this plan need @planner annotations
accepted_patterns: Every annotation-worthy file in `## Files To Modify` must declare at least one @planner: annotation.
Annotation-worthy paths (default): scripts/, src/, lib/, services/, .agent/skills/iterative-planner/scripts/.
Override the allowlist via PLANNER_ANNOTATION_WORTHY_GLOBS (semicolon-separated path prefixes).
paste_template: // At the top of <file>, replace each <FILL: ...> with a real value:
// OR declare a waiver in plan.md (in any section):
// [KB_NOT_APPLICABLE: annotation: <file-path>: <real reason, not TBD or placeholder>]

autofix.text: annotation_assist.mjs proposes high-confidence annotations from filename/structure heuristics; lower-confidence cases land in plans/annotation_review.md for review. After running, re-check your new files; the supervisor may still need @planner:story_id added manually.
